# Sleep Reset

> Sleep Reset is a personalized, science-backed sleep program based on Stanford's CBT-I protocol, offering virtual clinician visits, sleep coaching, and medication-free treatment for insomnia and sleep disorders.

Sleep Reset combines clinical expertise with digital health tools to deliver evidence-based insomnia treatment. The platform serves individual patients, employers, healthcare providers, and insurance partners with comprehensive sleep improvement solutions backed by medical experts and peer-reviewed research.

## Key Topics

- CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia)
- Insomnia treatment
- Sleep coaching
- Virtual clinician visits
- Sleep disorders
- Stanford Sleep Clinic
- Clinical sleep program
- Sleep assessment
- Insurance coverage
- Sleep quality improvement
- Behavioral sleep medicine
- Sleep-related mental health
- Mobile app (iOS/Android)
- HSA/FSA eligible
- Sleep science education

- [Sleep Reset - World-Class Sleep Program With Personalized Help](https://www.thesleepreset.com): Sleep Reset homepage: personalized, science-backed sleep program
- [Try Stanford Sleep Clinic's Gold Standard Treatment for Insomnia | Sleep Reset](https://www.thesleepreset.com/cbti-based-program): Stanford Sleep Clinic's CBT-I based insomnia treatment program
- [Sleep Reset | Virtual Clinician Visits](https://www.thesleepreset.com/sleep-reset-virtual-clinician-visits): Sleep Reset virtual clinician visits with insurance and HSA/FSA
- [lp-after-care](https://www.thesleepreset.com/lp-after-care): Sleep Reset After Care Program for ongoing sleep optimization
